provenancePolicy: Manually curated metadata and engineering review questions; NOT downloaded/full-text RAG, not evidence that a device is compliant.

sources.releaseScope: Version-specific commands must be checked against installed software
sources.title: Troubleshoot Border Gateway Protocol Basic Issues
questions: Does an observed non-Established FSM align with source-address, TCP/179, authentication and address-family evidence?
If Established, distinguish prefix reception from best-path and data-plane reachability.

sources.title: Arista EOS Border Gateway Protocol
questions: Do neighbor FSM and route-map/route-map application match the intended VRF/AFI-SAFI?
Check advertised/received prefix evidence without assuming a route-map not shown is absent.

sources.releaseScope: Cisco 2024 advisory (historical lab platforms); verify current platform applicability
sources.title: Troubleshoot OSPF Neighbors Stuck in Exstart/Exchange State
questions: Does the captured neighbor really remain in EXSTART/EXCHANGE over time?
Can interface MTU, area, router ID, ACL, and DBD behavior distinguish competing explanations?

sources.releaseScope: Cisco Nexus 9000 NX-OS 7.x examples; verify current NX-OS release
sources.title: Cisco Nexus 9000 VXLAN EVPN Verification
questions: What L2/L3 VNI and route-target mappings are explicitly configured?
Do observed Type-2/Type-5 routes, VTEP peers and L2RIB forwarding entries agree?

sources.releaseScope: Nexus 9000 NX-OS 10.2.x, feature applicability must be verified
sources.title: Cisco NX-OS Nexus 9000 vPC Interfaces Guide
questions: Separate observed peer-gateway enabled state from configuration display scope.
Can both sides substantiate peer-link/keepalive and consistency state at the same capture time?

sources.releaseScope: Arista EOS 4.37.x current online manual; confirm release
sources.title: Arista EOS Multi-Chassis Link Aggregation
questions: Check show mlag and config-sanity from both peers.
Is a port intentionally disabled or affected by peer-link and reload-delay state?

sources.releaseScope: FortiOS 7.4.8; service4 is applicable for 7.4.4+, older releases differ
sources.title: Fortinet FortiOS SD-WAN Related Diagnose Commands
questions: Separate probe state, SLA thresholds and selected service path.
Correlate BGP overlay state with transport reachability only if observed at comparable times.

sources.releaseScope: Architecture-level guidance; platform feature syntax is release scoped
sources.title: Cisco Campus Network for High Availability
questions: Does root placement match VLAN role and fault domains?
Are access and uplink protection features applied to evidenced port roles?
